text:
devon: Heads-up — saw a big spike in retry-related logs on staging earlier. Looks like SDKs are emitting raw idempotency keys and retry reasons for every attempt, which blew up Sentry and our metrics cardinality. Any parity gaps across languages or quick mitigations?

maria: Yup, noticed. JS SDK emits an event with `idempotency_key` on every attempt. We should stop shipping the raw key to telemetry.

jordan: Agree. We still need the key for server-side dedupe, but telemetry can use a digest. Proposal: hash the idempotency key (sha256 -> hex prefix) and include only the first 8 chars in events, plus a sampled mode to capture full keys for debugging. Example: 
```
// pseudocode
const key = req.headers['idempotency-key']
const digest = sha256(key).slice(0,8) // safe low-card representation
events.track('retry_attempt', { idempotency_digest: digest, retry_reason: reason })
```
Also add `X-Redwood-Retry-Reason` header for observability (but not index that in logs).

angela: Small parity note: Node uses exponential + full jitter by default. Python currently uses a fixed jitter window (ugly). We should normalize defaults across JS/Py/Go to `exp_backoff * full_jitter` and document the config knobs in the SDK README. Default jitter window idea: 50-500ms for 1-3 retries, scales up after that.

samir: For rollout: 1) stop sending raw keys by default, 2) send idempotency_digest in all SDK telemetry, 3) add a `telemetry.sample_full_keys` flag that enables 0.01 (1%) sampling of raw keys and attaches them to debug events only, gated by an env var and disabled in hosted mode. I'll draft a PR.

maria: We also need to patch the sample-app used in onboarding so that it demonstrates safe replay without printing the key. People copy-paste those examples. Replace any console.log of the idempotency key with `console.log('idempotency_digest', digest)` and a note about not logging PII.

jordan: Suggest adding an aggregation metric on the control plane: `sdk.retry.count` with labels {reason, idempotency_digest} but ensure digest is low-card (8 chars). For alerts, use percentiles on retries per session rather than distinct digest counts.

angela: UX friction: callers misconfigure idempotency for streaming endpoints. Let's add a warning when `Idempotency-Key` is set on streaming calls and recommend `session-id` header instead. Small doc update in the onboarding flow will cut down support tickets.

samir: I'll open two PRs: one for telemetry changes, one for sample-apps + docs. Planning to land non-breaking telemetry change behind feature flag first. Target: roll to canary SDK CI next week.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary release for devex-sdks queued (canary group: staging-only).

devon: Thanks — can we also add a test that asserts SDKs do NOT include raw `idempotency_key` in events by default? That will catch accidental regressions.

maria: Added to my checklist. I'll add a unit test + an integration smoke that toggles `telemetry.sample_full_keys` on and asserts sampled payloads include the full key only when enabled.

jordan: FYI linking internal doc for reference: https://redwood.internal/devex/retries-telemetry (internal).

samir: Will CC product on the PRs for signoff on sampling policy.

devon: Great — staying coordinated. If anyone runs into noisy Sentry alerts, tag me and I'll mute the alert while we roll the fix. :+1:
